from.place: Local-lift Cech computation of the connecting boundary, via a compatible horseshoe resolution

title: Local correction in the horseshoe Cech total complex
statement: For a scheme X and any compatible horseshoe of injective resolutions IA, IB, IC of a short complex S with short exact rows, let U be any family of opens, q a global section of S.X3, and x_i sections of S.X2 lifting q. Suppose b is a global section of IB^0 with beta(b)=aug_C(q), a is a global degree-one cycle of IA with alpha(a)=d b, and z is an S.X1-valued Cech degree-one cycle whose image under S.f has components x_i1-x_i0. Then H^1(moduleCechBeta U IA)([z])=H^1(moduleCechAlpha U IA)([a]). This statement contains no canonical comparison map and no module cohomology boundary.

source.place: Tag 01EQ, double-complex comparison proof; Tag 0B8S, local-lift computation

proof.text: Obtain the correction Cech zero cochain and its two prescribed differentials.

Include the correction into the (0,0) summand. Expand total_d using ι_D₁ and ι_D₂, then d₁_eq and d₂_eq. Both signs at (0,0) are +1. Substitute the two correction equations and unfold the alpha and beta components. Reorder the sum to get beta(iCycles z) - alpha(iCycles a) as the total differential.

Map z and a to cycles in the total complex. Injectivity of iCycles and cyclesMap_i identify their difference with toCycles of the correction. Apply homologyπ, use additivity and toCycles_comp_homologyπ, then homologyπ_naturality to obtain the unchanged conclusion.

proof_origin.note: Local calculation isolated into a cochain theorem. The total-sign expansion and homology argument are explicit Lean proofs using the existing definitions and Mathlib identities.

lean.statement:
theorem cech_horseshoe_lift_class (X : Scheme.{u})
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules)
    (IA : InjectiveResolution S.X₁) (IB : InjectiveResolution S.X₂)
    (IC : InjectiveResolution S.X₃)
    (α : IA.cocomplex ⟶ IB.cocomplex) (β : IB.cocomplex ⟶ IC.cocomplex)
    (hαβ : α ≫ β = 0)
    (hιA : IA.ι ≫ α = (CochainComplex.single₀ X.Modules).map S.f ≫ IB.ι)
    (hιB : IB.ι ≫ β = (CochainComplex.single₀ X.Modules).map S.g ≫ IC.ι)
    (hrows : ∀ k : ℕ, ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map
      (HomologicalComplex.eval X.Modules (ComplexShape.up ℕ) k)).ShortExact)
    {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (q : S.X₃.val.obj (op ⊤)) (x : ∀ i : ι, S.X₂.val.obj (op (U i)))
    (hx : ∀ i : ι, S.g.val.app (op (U i)) (x i) =
      S.X₃.val.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U i ≤ ⊤)).op q)
    (b : (IB.cocomplex.X 0).val.obj (op ⊤))
    (a : (RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex IA).cycles 1)
    (hb : (β.f 0).val.app (op ⊤) b = (IC.ι.f 0).val.app (op ⊤) q)
    (ha : (α.f 1).val.app (op ⊤)
      ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex IA).iCycles 1 a) =
        (IB.cocomplex.d 0 1).val.app (op ⊤) b)
    (z : ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj S.X₁.presheafModuleCat).cycles 1)
    (hz : ∀ y : Fin 2 → ι,
      S.f.val.app (op (∏ᶜ fun k : Fin 2 ↦ U (y k)))
        ((Pi.π (fun w : Fin 2 → ι ↦
          S.X₁.presheafModuleCat.obj (op (∏ᶜ fun k : Fin 2 ↦ U (w k)))) y)
          (((cechComplexFunctor U).obj S.X₁.presheafModuleCat).iCycles 1 z)) =
        S.X₂.val.presheaf.map (Pi.π (fun k : Fin 2 ↦ U (y k)) 1).op (x (y 1)) -
          S.X₂.val.presheaf.map (Pi.π (fun k : Fin 2 ↦ U (y k)) 0).op (x (y 0))) :
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (moduleCechBeta U IA) 1
      (((cechComplexFunctor U).obj S.X₁.presheafModuleCat).homologyπ 1 z) =
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (moduleCechAlpha U IA) 1
          ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex IA).homologyπ 1 a)
